verdicts.reason: A keeps the card cleanly behind the text and the book on the left, so the left-to-right banner order works. Its flaws: the Inkwell & Lantern logo is shrunk to an illegible speck, the CTA pill is tiny and outweighed by the large body copy, and the fine print is unreadably small. B is broken. The headline, body copy, logo and fine print all sit directly on busy confetti, and the card has collapsed into a stray small rectangle behind the body text. Confetti pieces cut into the body and legal text, so text is lost and the layout looks like it fell apart.
